metadata.title: Turn a broad idea into a testable product scope
metadata.excerpt: Use a small scope canvas to name one audience, one painful situation, one promised change and the riskiest assumption to test next.

hero.alt: A broad cloud of product ideas narrowing into one audience, one problem and one testable assumption.
hero.caption: A useful first scope narrows the decision before it expands the feature list.

inlineVisuals.alt: Three stacked cards distinguish an idea, a user problem and a proposed solution.
inlineVisuals.caption: Separating these three statements keeps a proposed feature from masquerading as evidence.

inlineVisuals.alt: A completed fictional scope canvas with audience, current workaround, promised change, non-goals and a decision rule.
inlineVisuals.caption: Fictional example: a small neighborhood repair service tests request clarity before building scheduling automation.

downloads.label: Download the scope canvas as PDF
downloads.description: A print-ready scope canvas with a fictional completed example and completion check.

downloads.label: Download the editable scope canvas as DOCX
downloads.description: An editable scope canvas with the same prompts and fictional example as the PDF.

interactiveResources.label: Open the Opportunity Brief Builder
interactiveResources.description: Complete the same reasoning in a browser and export the result as Markdown.

resourceCallout.heading: Use the scope resources
resourceCallout.intro: Choose the format that fits the way you want to work. The downloads contain the same core prompts, and the builder stays on thexap.com.
